description: Cancel listings waiting in the listing automation's queue on a one-item-per-listing marketplace (Vinted), by job id from list_listing_jobs. Nothing is sent to the marketplace and no live listing changes; the products simply are not listed for that reason. A job a run is sending right now, or one already closed, is not cancelled and comes back in notCancelled. Idempotent. Returns { cancelled, notCancelled } and echoes the workspace.

jobIds.description: Ids of queued listings (1 to 100) from list_listing_jobs. Only waiting ones are cancelled; one a run is sending right now, or already closed, comes back in notCancelled.

platform.description: The marketplace the listings were queued for. Only vinted has listing automation today.

name: cancel_listing_jobs
title: Cancel queued listings
